name: K-D Tree Construction for Volume Rendering
definition: A recursive algorithm that builds a K-D tree from an Octree to optimize volume rendering by partitioning space based on QEF variance, enabling efficient contouring and mesh extraction.
summary: K-D Tree Construction for Volume Rendering builds a K-D tree from a Sparse Voxel Octree, optimizing rendering by recursively partitioning space based on Quadratic Error Function variance.
